description: Fork of exp004 with joint Q/K LUT. Replaces separate q_perm + k_perm (each BitPermutationLUT(n_outputs=d_qk=24, output_nap=24)) with one BitMultiHeadLUT(n_outputs=2*P_qk=552, output_nap=2*qk_output_nap=48). Q is the first P_qk slots, K is the next P_qk. Single anchor lookup → tied Q/K lookup decision per token; eliminates the 'moving target' between two independent LUTs that have to coordinate via gradient. Same total latents (3.15M bf16) and same votes-per-pair (~22) as exp004.
